# Average & statistics

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/statistics/

Calculate descriptive statistics for a list of finite numbers. Review the mean, median, range, modes, sum and population or sample standard deviation.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Summarize a set of practice scores or compare the spread of a small measurement list.

## Limits and checks

Separate numbers with spaces, commas or line breaks. Sample standard deviation needs at least two observations.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
